description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers of a model, comparing various token-precision configurations for KV cache compression. The x-axis represents the layer ranges: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, while the y-axis shows the relative change in performance, ranging from -15% to 5%, with a horizontal dashed line at 0% indicating the baseline performance. The baseline is defined as the performance of a 4× tokens, 4-bit configuration, represented by a gray dashed line. The yellow line with circular markers, labeled "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit," starts at approximately 0% relative change for Layer1-4, dips slightly to around -1% for Layer5-12, rises to about 0.5% for Layer13-20, remains flat at 0% for Layer21-28, and ends at approximately 1% for Layer29-32. The red line with square markers, labeled "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit," begins at about 0.5% for Layer1-4, decreases to around -2% for Layer5-12, then slightly increases to -1% for Layer13-20, remains at -1% for Layer21-28, and ends at approximately 0.5% for Layer29-32. The light blue line with circular markers, labeled "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit," starts at about -1% for Layer1-4, decreases to around -5% for Layer5-12, drops further to approximately -7% for Layer13-20, then increases to about -4% for Layer21-28, and finally rises to around -1% for Layer29-32. The dark blue line with square markers, labeled "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit," begins at approximately -1% for Layer1-4, decreases to around -6% for Layer5-12, drops significantly to about -14% for Layer13-20, then increases to approximately -10% for Layer21-28, and finally rises to around -2% for Layer29-32. The plot suggests that the performance varies across layers, with some configurations showing significant degradation in the middle layers (Layer13-20) and recovery in the later layers (Layer29-32).
